svg.text: 4 · Target model: Snowflake WWI_ANALYTICS.GOLD (enterprise star schemas)

8 conformed dimensions and 6 facts, built by dbt from the Silver layer. Names are snake_case and types are Snowflake types. One date dimension serves every date role (order, picked, invoice, delivery).
fact · one row per order line
fact · one row per invoice line
fact · one row per customer or supplier transaction
dimension · one row per calendar day
fact · one row per stock movement
fact · one row per purchase order line
fact · one row per stock item (current snapshot)
PK = surrogate key built by dbt; FK = key of a dimension row.
Dimensions keep history as SCD Type 2 (valid_from / valid_to).
lineage_key records the load batch that wrote the row.
Several role-playing date keys all point to the single GOLD.DIM_DATE.
